name: OE Solar
old_description: OE Solar was started over 16 years ago as Osceola Energy, Inc. with the objective to install solar across New Mexico.  Over the years, our vision and focus have evolved, as well as our name. Today, OE Solar is focused on bringing renewable centered solutions to enterprises who are climate-aware and looking for economic solutions for their power needs. We were founded on the principles of honesty, craftsmanship, and ownership, giving local governments and businesses the confidence they need from a company focused on enterprise solutions. We are proud to be a trusted local company in New Mexico that focuses on renewable solutions for private and public sector projects throughout the state.
about:
OE Solar is headquartered in Albuquerque, New Mexico. The company was founded in 2009 as Osceola Energy, Inc. with the original goal of installing solar across the state. It is a woman‑owned small business that rebranded to OE Solar as its focus expanded to enterprise‑level renewable energy solutions for both private and public sector clients.

The firm operates as a full‑service engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) contractor for commercial solar photovoltaic systems, battery energy storage systems (BESS), EV charging infrastructure, solar carports, and microgrid installations. It also provides operations and maintenance, community solar development, and pre‑construction planning. To date, OE Solar reports 6.8 MW of solar installed across more than 2,100 clients over 17 years in business; facility size and employee count are not disclosed.

OE Solar serves commercial and industrial businesses, federal, state, and local government agencies, Tribal Nations, military installations, educational institutions, and hospitality venues. Named clients include Santa Ana Casino, Santa Ana Golf Club, Albuquerque Public Schools, and the Picuris Pueblo — for whom the company built New Mexico’s first community solar project.

The company emphasizes its GSA‑approved, woman‑owned small business status, NABCEP certification, and Tesla and ChargePoint certified installers as differentiators. It also highlights deep expertise in government energy policy, established relationships with regulators and policymakers, and a founding philosophy built on honesty, craftsmanship, and ownership.

name: Obertron Electronic Manufacturing Inc
old_description: Since 1986, we’ve been committed to skilled craftsmanship and responsive service to ensure every product meets our customers’ needs. By combining advanced technology with honest communication, we aim to be a trusted partner for your success.
about:
Obertron Electronic Manufacturing has operated from Manchester, Michigan since its founding in 1986. The company provides PCB assembly services from a single Midwestern facility, emphasizing skilled craftsmanship and responsive service.

The shop specializes in medium-volume, high-mix PCBA assembly, combining automated surface-mount placement (including 01005, QFN, BGA, and fine-pitch components) with through-hole selective and hand soldering. It offers full turnkey support—component procurement, inventory holding, conformal coating, potting, box build, and mechanical assembly—alongside PCB fabrication sourcing for boards up to 36 layers with trace/space tolerances of 0.003″ outer and 0.002″ inner. All work is performed to IPC-A-610 Class 2/3 and ISO 9001:2015 standards, with 100% visual inspection and 3D AOI coverage.

Customers span LED lighting, service industries (commercial, hospitality, healthcare), test and measurement, instrumentation, industrial equipment, medical and health devices, aerospace and automotive (including EV), agriculture and industrial automation, commercial and recreational electronics, and R&D prototypes.

Obertron differentiates itself through lean manufacturing, ongoing staff training, flexible production scheduling, and a standard 5–6 week lead time. A one-year labor warranty and transparent quoting reinforce its focus on dependable partnerships.

name: Ohio Steel Industries
old_description: Founded in 1958, Ohio Steel Industries began business with one employee operating principally as a structural steel fabricator, in a 25,000 square feet facility in Columbus, Ohio. Our market and delivery area then was the central Ohio area. Our company today operates in multiple facilities and locations of more than 300,000 square feet providing material, products and services throughout the world.
about:
Ohio Steel Industries was founded in 1958 in Columbus, Ohio, when a single employee began operating a structural steel fabrication shop in a 25,000-square-foot facility serving central Ohio. The company has since expanded to multiple locations totaling more than 300,000 square feet and serves customers worldwide.

The business operates through three divisions. The Manufacturing Division provides contract fabrication of lawn and garden riding mower attachments, utility trailers, loading ramps, and display merchandising, using processes that include stamping, welding, bending, cutting, forming, powder coating, packaging, and shipping. OSI Plastics, an ISO 9001:2015-registered division, produces extruded plastic profiles for utilities, telecommunications firms, and other large enterprises across the United States and Europe. The Structural Steel Division, housed in a 120,000-square-foot plant in Pataskala, fabricates, furnishes, and erects structural steel for buildings and bridges and holds AISC certification for standard, simply supported, and major bridge structures.

Customers range from retail mass merchants and OEM lawn-and-garden manufacturers to distributors, dealers, public utilities, and telecommunications companies. The structural division serves the construction sector, while the plastics division supplies large publicly traded companies. Products are shipped globally, with a particular presence in the U.S. and European markets.

The company states its commitments as providing a safe workplace, exceeding customer expectations in quality and delivery, expanding its market through research and development, developing and retaining its workforce, and creating jobs in its community. Its differentiators include AISC-certified structural fabrication, ISO 9001:2015 registration for plastics, and full-service metal fabrication under one roof.

name: Orion Plastics
old_description: Orion Plastics Inc. was founded in 2001 as a custom manufacturer of polyethylene bags, sheeting and tubing. Our Location in compton, california has several extrusion lines capable of producing millions of pounds of product annually and offers our customers the ultimate in flexibility wiithout sacrificing dependability.
about:
Orion Plastics Inc. was founded in 2001 in Compton, California, as a custom manufacturer of polyethylene bags, sheeting, and tubing. The company operates from a single location in Compton with several extrusion lines.

The company produces a wide range of polyethylene products including bags (box liners, bin liners, pallet covers, hazardous waste bags, furniture and mattress bags), sheeting (agricultural, mulch film, shrink bundling, anti-static), and tubing (anti-static, shrink, perforated, continuous on roll). Its extrusion lines are capable of producing millions of pounds of product annually, supported by printing capabilities (1C-2S and 2C-1S) and converting equipment for loose bags, roll bags, and gusseted configurations up to 144 inches wide. Gauges run up to 0.010 inch, with standard 3-inch ID cores and roll diameters from 8 to 30 inches.

Orion serves customers in food processing (FDA compliant and SQF certified), agriculture, construction, hazardous waste management, asbestos abatement, furniture and bedding, and textile industries. Specific product examples include FDA-compliant box liners, agricultural mulch film, hazardous waste bags, asbestos removal bags, and furniture and mattress bags.

The company emphasizes flexibility without sacrificing dependability, offering custom sizing, venting options, slip levels, and leak-proof seals. Its FDA compliance and SQF certification support food-contact applications.

name: P & M Apparel
old_description: "The team at P&M Apparel are fantastic.  Timely, communicative, and thoughtful about their work.  I worked with a few different people at P&M and all of them listened well to what we needed and were able to translate our needs/vision into something tangible.  The quality of the materials and print were excellent.  The people are even better.  Definitely recommend."
about:
P & M Apparel operates from Polk City, Iowa, where it was founded in 1987 by Phyllis and Melvin — the P and M — after careers in farming and home remodeling. The business began in their basement and moved to Polk City as it grew. Their daughter Kay took over leadership, and in 2023 ownership passed to the third generation: Megan Griffith and Ryan Toney. The company is certified as woman-owned and remains family-run.

The shop provides screen printing, embroidery, direct-to-film digital printing, vinyl, glitter, rhinestone, puff, and sublimation decoration, plus live event printing, online team stores, and promotional product sourcing. With a crew of 16, the facility handles orders ranging from a single piece to runs exceeding 10,000 units. All artwork is created in-house, and every job receives a proof before production.

Customers include schools, sports teams, businesses, nonprofits, dance studios, churches, and community organizations across Iowa and nationally. The company has shipped to 29 countries and produces state tournament apparel with no rush fees, corporate swag, fundraising merchandise, and uniform programs.

The founders’ philosophy centers on “great apparel builds belonging” and a service model that prioritizes fast answers, kept promises, and problem-solving over transactional decoration. Roughly 90 percent of business comes from referrals, a result the owners attribute to acting as a single partner for all decoration methods rather than a vendor list.

name: PB Metal
old_description: Since 2010, PB Metal Fab, employee-owned and operated, has established itself as a premier provider of high-quality parts and metal fabrication services across the Midwestern states, committed to delivering cost-effective, prompt, and reliable solutions tailored to our clients' needs. As a full-service metal processing job shop, our core equipment includes state-of-the-art flat-sheet lasers, tube lasers, and advanced forming, rolling, welding, machining, and finishing tools, enabling us to streamline processes such as fabrication, assembly, and more under one roof. Over the years, we have invested in cutting-edge technology, including automated material storage systems that significantly enhance our productivity. Our continuous growth led to the construction of a new 40,000-square-foot facility in 2012, and with an expansion of 67,000 square feet in 2024, our total manufacturing space now totals 110,000 square feet. This expansion allows us to better serve increasing market demands while maintaining our core focus—being entirely customer-driven to meet and exceed client expectations.
about:
PB Metal Fab, an employee-owned metal fabrication job shop, was founded in 2010 in Ipswich, South Dakota, near the regional hub of Aberdeen. The company began with a focus on providing high-quality parts and fabrication services across the Midwestern states.

Operating from a 110,000-square-foot facility built in phases—a 40,000-square-foot plant in 2012 and a 67,000-square-foot expansion in 2024—the shop runs flat-sheet and tube lasers, a 150-metric-ton press brake, 20-by-40-inch machining centers, an 8-inch four-roll plate roller, in-house shot blasting, and automated material storage. Its service list covers fiber laser cutting, water jet cutting, CNC forming, machining, plate rolling, welding (aluminum, stainless, mild steel), shot blasting, material sales, and CAD/CAM support.

The company serves a diverse customer base throughout North America, though specific industry sectors are not publicly detailed. Its capabilities are geared toward clients needing precision cutting, forming, and post-processing of metals and non-metals such as marble and granite.

PB Metal Fab emphasizes a customer-driven approach, citing prompt, cost-effective delivery and a single-source workflow from cutting through finishing as key differentiators. The employee-ownership model is presented as a structural advantage for accountability and responsiveness.

name: PICO Manufacturing Sales Corporation
old_description: Since 1931, Pico has been family-owned and operated, and we’ve earned our reputation as the premier resource for all aspects of your garment and brand building needs. Innovation, product design, merchandising, and package design dictate our high-quality underwear and sleepwear for men, women, and children imports.
about:
PICO Manufacturing Sales Corporation was founded in 1931 in New York, New York, and has remained family-owned and operated since its inception. In 1958, Ira Litt joined the company and established its headquarters in the Empire State Building, situating the business in the heart of the Garment District.

The company designs, develops, and manufactures a full range of underwear and sleepwear — including boxer briefs, woven boxers, base layers, flame-resistant children's sleepwear, and active lifestyle apparel — for men, women, and children. Operations span product design, yarn and fabric development, merchandising, and package design. Production was relocated to Dayton, Tennessee in 1973, and the company handles orders ranging from 500 to 500,000 units.

PICO serves the apparel industry as a private-label manufacturer for department stores, mass retailers, and specialty stores, and acts as a strategic license partner for major brands in the underwear and sleepwear categories.

The company emphasizes its vertically integrated approach — developing proprietary yarns and fabrics, maintaining trend-focused design, and offering dedicated customer service throughout the process. It also highlights a sustainability commitment, holding BCI, OEKO-TEX, WRAP, Sedex, and CTPAT certifications, with a goal of 80% renewable energy use by 2021.

name: PREMOLD CORP
old_description: On June 30th, 2022, Ken Schweitz sadly passed away. As a founder and president since 1995, Ken’s tremendous work ethic, high standards, and dedication to the company, employees, and customers have helped Premold Corp become North America’s largest supplier of World-Class Reaction Injection Molding. His values and standards have become engrained in Premold’s culture and will ensure enormous support for continuous success and growth going forward. By leaving behind his legacy of what Premold Corp has become the team thanks Ken Schweitz for all his work and care over the past decades.
about:
Premold Corp was founded in 1995 by Ken Schweitz in Oconomowoc, Wisconsin. The privately owned company operates two facilities in Oconomowoc and a third in Monterrey, Mexico. After Ken Schweitz's passing in 2022, his daughter Ximena Schweitz assumed the presidency, continuing the family's leadership in reaction injection molding (RIM).

The company specializes in reaction injection molding, producing rigid polyurethane parts for low-volume and prototype applications. Its capabilities span in-house tool making with CNC-machined aluminum molds, cast urethane and stereolithography prototyping, short-run production with just-in-time delivery, finish painting using Sherwin Williams Polane coatings, UL-recognized EMI shielding, silk-screen and pad-print graphics, and full assembly including procurement and sub-assembly. The RIM process allows complex geometries, varying wall thicknesses without sink marks, and molded-in features that eliminate secondary machining.

Premold serves a range of industries with a focus on medical and laboratory instrumentation, supplying molded housings, bezels, and skins. Customers include medical device manufacturers requiring custom low-volume polyurethane components.

The company differentiates itself through a single-source model that integrates tooling, molding, finishing, and assembly under one roof, reducing lead times and enabling design-for-manufacture collaboration from prototype through production.

name: Pacific Auto Company
old_description: Since 1983, Pacific Best Inc. (PBI) has been a trusted manufacturer and distributor of automotive cooling products. We offer a wide range of products, including radiators, condensers, fan assemblies, intercoolers, external oil coolers, cabin air filters, door mirrors, and more for most makes and models. With distribution centers in Virginia, Texas, and California, we provide fast delivery and exceptional service nationwide and beyond. Our commitment to customer service, high fill rates, and rapid shipping ensures our clients can serve their customers efficiently and with maximum satisfaction. Our manufacturing partners utilize the most advanced equipment and are operated by experienced, professional teams. At Pacific Best Inc., we place a strong emphasis on process control to ensure uncompromised quality. Our partners are ISO/TS16949 certified and are dedicated to producing premium-quality products at the most competitive prices.
about:
Pacific Auto Company, operating as Pacific Best Inc., was established in 1983 in Paramount, California, within the Los Angeles metropolitan area. The company began as a warehouse distributor of automotive collision body parts and cooling products, serving the Southern California repair market.

Today, Pacific Auto Company maintains six distribution centers across Southern California, supported by over nine warehouses and a dedicated delivery fleet. The company stocks a complete line of aftermarket collision parts — including radiators, condensers, fan assemblies, intercoolers, external oil coolers, cabin air filters, door mirrors, and lighting — all certified to meet OEM replacement standards. Its lighting products comply with DOT/SAE regulations, and it carries an extensive selection of CAPA- and NSF-certified body parts. The firm reports over 30 million parts sold since inception.

The distributor serves a broad base of automotive repair professionals: collision repair shops, auto body shops, jobbers, insurance providers, estimation services, auto parts retailers, dealerships, restoration specialists, and wrecking yards. Its coverage area spans eight Southern California counties — Santa Barbara, Kern, Ventura, Los Angeles, San Bernardino, Riverside, and Orange — with guaranteed 24-hour delivery on business days.

Pacific Auto Company differentiates itself through a no-contract, no-buy-in account structure, volume discount programs, and a procurement team that uses data analytics to maintain high fill rates. The company emphasizes competitive pricing on every order and a quality administration system designed to streamline ordering and same-day dispatch.

name: Pacific Packaging Products, Inc. - South
old_description: Founded in 1952, Pacific Packaging Products Inc. provides expert business solutions to increase our customers’ competitive edge and profitability. Whether it is in packaging design, packaging manufacturing and converting, packaging equipment and automation, or the utilization of Pacific’s unparalleled USA coast-to-coast, Canadian, Mexican and Caribbean infrastructure to deliver lean, supply chain solutions, Pacific is the optimal partner for your demanding business. Pacific has the leverage and reach of a large multinational corporation, with the flexibility and innovation of a family owned, independent company.
about:
Pacific Packaging Products, Inc. – South operates from Nashville, Tennessee, where the company was founded in 1952 as a family‑owned independent business. The firm began by supplying industrial packaging materials and has since expanded into a coast‑to‑coast network of distribution centers and converting facilities.

The company provides a full range of packaging products, equipment, and automation systems, backed by in‑house converting capabilities that include slitting, rewinding, die cutting, sheeting, flexographic label and bag printing, and custom tape printing. It also offers packaging design, engineering and testing, kitting and contract packaging, and fulfillment services for direct‑mail operations. Pacific’s infrastructure spans multiple U.S. locations, supporting national accounts with inventory management and lean supply‑chain programs.

Customers come from food and beverage, military and defense, retail point‑of‑purchase, general manufacturing, healthcare and pharmaceuticals, automotive, and fulfillment/direct‑mail sectors. The company also specializes in cold‑chain packaging for seafood and perishable goods, supplying insulated shippers, refrigerants, and temperature‑monitoring devices.

Pacific positions itself as a hybrid partner that combines the reach and leverage of a large multinational supplier with the agility and responsiveness of a family‑owned independent company. Its stated differentiation lies in end‑to‑end integration—from concept and prototyping through converting, printing, automation, and final pack‑out—designed to reduce handling steps and total supply‑chain cost.
